description:
Use this when the user asks which stocks are in an Indian index such as NIFTY 50 or NIFTY Bank.

Returns the stocks in an index, largest first, with ISIN, NSE symbol, sector and market cap. `index` is an index name such as NIFTY 50 or BSE SENSEX; a name that is not recognised returns the valid ones. `limit` is 1 to 500 (default 100). It gives membership only, not index weights.

as_of.description: Optional date YYYY-MM-DD: the members on that date, from the index membership record (complete from the index's history start). Omit for the current members.
as_of.title: As Of

index.description: Index name, e.g. "NIFTY 50" or "BSE SENSEX" (a name, not a slug).
index.title: Index

name: list_index_constituents
title: Index constituents
